rules.correspondence: One directed edge per archival item from each named sender to each named recipient. Copies, drafts, telegrams, excerpts, enclosures and form slips all count as attestations that A wrote to B. Offices (o_*) stand for unnamed signers.
rules.stated: A relation asserted inside a document by its writer (partner, friend, officer of the same company, familiar salutation, recommendation, request). Each edge carries the quotation that asserts it.
rules.pi: A relation asserted in the principal investigator's own writing (Cast of Characters, Tale §3, timeline summaries). Kept separate because it is interpretation, not attestation.
rules.affiliation: Person to institution, derived from the roles recorded in the prosopography (each role cites its source).
rules.exclusions: No tie is inferred from co-mention, shared location, or outside knowledge. Mentions are indexed per document but are not edges.
